note: SMS IS HIDDEN AGAIN, THE NEWSLETTER AND QUICKBOOKS WITH IT, AND FREE SWAPS CRM FOR SIGNUPS. The founder, after a production crash on /admin/sms: 'lets better hide sms feature entirely again and keep it for when ill add the scheduler. people can receive the serving notif from church service planner through resend mail.' SMS_FEATURE_ENABLED goes back to false and nothing is deleted to hide it, which is what that switch was built for; two new switches in the identical shape (newsletter-feature.ts, quickbooks-feature.ts, both importing nothing) hide the newsletter and the QuickBooks integration the same way, on the founder's 'put SMS and newsletter to coming soon. Hide newsletter from the app' and 'hide quickbooks connection entirely because I did not check it'. The crash itself is RECORDED RATHER THAN FIXED, because the feature is being withdrawn: React #31 on 'Check availability' is ZernioAvailableNumber.features, typed string[] and passed through /api/sms/numbers unvalidated, rendered as a bare Badge child in settings/SmsSection.tsx while the vendor answers with {name} objects. ONE SURFACE THE SMS SWITCH DID NOT REACH was found and closed: THE-324's /api/rota/invitations reported smsAvailable from the plan cell alone, so a Ministry panel promised a text the funnel then refused; it reads the master switch first now. The free tier's split needed a NEW PLAN CELL and could not be a flag flip: AdminDashboard gated BOTH the CRM screen and the Signups screen on `crm`, so crm:false on free would have taken Signups — and the analytics that has lived on it since THE-277 — away in the same edit. `signups` is added, read by two real gates in AdminDashboard, and free is crm:false / signups:true. No analytics cell was invented. firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json and functions/ are untouched, no price moved, STRIPE_CONNECT_ENABLED and CUSTOM_DOMAIN_ENABLED are still false, and no npm dependency or theme token was added.

entries.why: THREE EDITS, EACH A GATE. (1) The Newsletter nav entry and its render branch gain NEWSLETTER_FEATURE_ENABLED in front of the plan and permission clauses, in the exact shape the SMS entry above it already uses — master switch first, so nobody gets the entry, super admin included, and the 'newsletter' id STAYS in the CONTENT group array so the grouping survives the flip back and admin-sections.ts's drift test still reads the literal. The render branch answers 'Page not found.' rather than PlanUpgradeScreen, for the reason the SMS branch does: that screen sells the tier that includes the feature, which would advertise the newsletter on the very screen meant to hide it, and the tiers that own newsletterAutomation cannot use it either. (2) The `signups` nav entry and render branch move off `features.crm` and onto the new `features.signups` cell. This is THE-335's only structural change and it was unavoidable: THE-277 carried this gate over as `crm` when it moved Analytics out of the CRM screen, which was right while the two were entitled together, and the founder has since split them — 'The free plan should have signup feature not CRM since we separated them.' While both gates read one cell, crm:false on free took the Signups screen and its analytics with it. The `analytics` PERMISSION half is untouched, and no analytics plan cell was invented: 'free gets analytics' is now expressed by signups:true and nothing else, the same sentence moved to the screen analytics actually lives on. The upgrade wall's featureKey moves with it so it names the tier that grants Signups rather than the tier that grants CRM. (3) Nothing else. The rail, the flyouts, MORE_GROUPS, DESKTOP_NAV_GROUPS, the mobile sheet, every other screen mount and every other gate are byte-identical in behaviour; no colour literal, no width and no emoji was added.
